2. Actual electrochemically regulated adhesion construction and source limits

ROOT completed local identity/alias/hold checks before each new primary navigation. Initial Choi etal2025, High-Performance Electrochemical Adhesives Enabled by Perfluorinated Sulfonic-Acid Ionomers with Precise Adhesion Control and Long-Term Switchability, DOI10.1002/advs.202510512, exact https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12622435/ main throughline177 supplies an actual PFSA ionomer/Au50nm/Cu-foil interface with PET132um backing. Positive Cu-side current promotes the interfacial coordination state; reversing bias weakens attachment. The read main lap-shear experiment used1cm2 and.1mA for0--90s: force1.10N at0s and4.81N at60s; raising current from.1 to.3mA at60s increased force4.1 to8.4N, with less than1C heating. At charge3,6,12mC/cm2 the read estimated fracture-energy points were1.07+/-.06,2.02+/-.12,3.92+/-.24J/m2. Their geometry/compliance is indispensable.

The main relation F_c=sqrt(2*G_c*A/C_total) explicitly depends on specimen compliance. Reported high lap-shear stress is not a universal normal-strength or mode-I law. The initial author-summary statements about50cycles, two-month retention and a separate high-strength/compliance-controlled clutch case do not supply jointly qualified normal load, dimensions, film preparation, humidity or500-cycle life. The read initial XPS preparation used much greater327mC/cm2 than the6mC/cm2 mechanical example; its chemical-state observation is not a closed material inventory for every operational cycle.

The FIRST further governing open returned browser-check/reCAPTCHA; this identity is HELD. No challenge/reload/Wiley/PMC/PDF/author/version/provider/title/SI/export recovery. Later cyclic/clutch/retention details and Experimental were NOT read. No linked original/SI/media was followed.

source_excerpts.text:
3. Bonding and electrically triggered release already exist

ROOT read selected actual description/examples of US20080196828A1, Electrically Disbonding Adhesive Compositions and Related Methods, exact https://patents.google.com/patent/US20080196828A1/en, including electrolyte/thermoplastic phase separation and room-temperature electrically weakened interfaces. Examples at20C include an initially250psi lap bond released under25psi with50V after110s and8.6mC/cm2; the lower-voltage8.5V example takes495s and3mC/cm2. Other read tensile examples differ in formulation, strength, residual force and time. They are not one jointly interchangeable material.

The patent also reports crystallization, solvent migration and evaporation affecting conductivity or strength with age; compatibility and wetting are real manufacturing variables. Hot-melt application requires heating/cooling; voltage release is not proof of repeated room-temperature rebonding or recovery of the original chemical/topographic state. No legal-novelty judgment, cited patent or PDF followed.

Distinct EIC-sourced manufacturer text at https://www.adhesivesandsealants.com/doc/electrelease-e4-0001 reports typical lap shear>2500psi on suitable metals,1h80C or24hroom cure and10--50VDC disbonding,5s--20min depending on load and voltage. These maker statements establish a strong existing disbond-on-demand alternative, not a current stock/price/life certificate or a repeatable rejoin campaign.

4. Strong dry-adhesive competitor already separates holding from release

ROOT read Jiang etal, Scaling Controllable Adhesives to Grapple Floating Objects in Space, exact https://bdml.stanford.edu/uploads/Main/AdhesionPublications/SpaceGripper.pdf main pp0--4 throughline489. Two opposed6.5cm2 directional pads supply roughly13N normal force on clean glass. The actual construction uses shear-loaded pads, spring or differential-pulley load sharing, outriggers, controlled peel-release tendons, lead-screw/worm hold, contact switches and a minimum-preload trigger. The read five-trial load-distribution experiment compares rigid, near-constant-force and pulley arrangements; the latter two improve force sharing. This is actual prior construction, not a new invention merely by naming compliance, segmentation, low release effort or passive holding.

The first further governing open atline510 returned400Timeout; SAME identity is HELD. Later TableI and remaining zero-G/air-bearing/discussion sections are unread. This paper's references to30000 cycles or earlier material qualification retain secondary scope only; those cited originals were not followed. No author/publisher/version/PDF/SI/export recovery.
